messages.text: Welcome to QuickCart support. How can I help you today?
My grocery delivery was supposed to arrive between 10 and 11 this morning, but it still hasn't come.
I'm sorry about that. I see your driver had car trouble. Your order has been given to a new driver and should arrive by 2:30.
That's a problem. I'm leaving for work at 2, and there's ice cream in the order.
I understand. I can cancel the frozen items and refund them, or move the whole order to tomorrow morning at no charge.
Tomorrow morning is better. Will I still have to pay the delivery fee?
No, we will remove the fee for this order. Your groceries will arrive between 8 and 9 A.M.

questions.stem: Why is Ms. Reyes's order late?
options: A. The store ran out of ice cream.
B. The original driver had a vehicle problem.
C. She entered the wrong address.
D. Her order was sent to her office.
questions.explanation: Leo explains, "I see your driver had car trouble."

questions.stem: At 1:06 P.M., why does Ms. Reyes mention ice cream?
options: A. To add another item to her order
B. To complain that it arrived melted
C. To explain why a late delivery would not work
D. To ask for a discount on frozen food
questions.explanation: She will leave at 2, before the 2:30 delivery, so frozen items would be left outside and melt.

questions.stem: What will most likely happen next?
options: A. She will pick up the order at the store.
B. Her frozen items will be refunded.
C. A driver will arrive at 2:30 today.
D. Her groceries will be delivered the next morning.
questions.explanation: She chooses the second option: "Tomorrow morning is better."
